column1: # B1 each input alone, under each variant (strict: ForceStrict, text unchanged), bytecode and native; B2 the conformance root's composition, bytecode; B3 eval code under E0-E7, bytecode; B4 the slice front end, once per input, under its goal, text unchanged.
# reading 1: alone in B1 is nothing composed around the input; a module is compiled with the graph the conformance root's resolution reaches from it, so its hash covers the modules it reaches.

# reading 2: the outcomes are accepted and refused; not-compiled is reported, never left out, in two cases only: B2's test262 _FIXTURE rows (note fixture), which the conformance root never composes alone, and B4's json rows (note no-json-goal), for which the slice front end has no goal.
# reading 3: any other not-compiled row, and every crashed row (an exception left the compiler), is an incomplete run.
# diagnostics are code:line:column in the order the compiler reported them; sha256 and length are the artifact's, for an accepted compilation.
